snippet.title: Hubert - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A peaceful adventure seen through the eyes of a loyal shepherd dog.

Wishlist on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/764930/Hubert/

Experience the quiet beauty of nature, guide your herd, and uncover the small stories hidden in the wilderness.

Features:
• Explore vast, atmospheric landscapes
• Guide and protect your herd through natural obstacles
• Discover a touching, minimalist story
• Enjoy a calm and cinematic experience powered by Unreal Engine
